common.part:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: character sprite SHEET for a 2:1 isometric pixel-art office game (paper-doll part system): 10 animation frames of ONE character in a fixed 5x2 grid
Style/medium: crisp pixel art in the style of Image 2 (style only, do not copy its characters): clean chunky pixels, one-art-pixel dark plum outline, 3-tone cel shading per material, cozy pastel palette, no dithering, no gradients, no blur; chibi proportions exactly as the mannequins
Lighting: soft light from DIRECTLY ABOVE; the two visible side faces share the SAME mid tone. No cast shadows.
Composition/framing: exactly one painted figure over each grey mannequin of Image 1: same size, same foot position, same pose, same facing; keep the 5x2 grid, the spacing and every figure position EXACTLY. The tiny box on a head marks where the face points; do not draw it as an object.
Background: fully transparent background (alpha). If transparency is impossible, use a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 background.
Avoid: chairs, desks, props, text, numbers, frame borders, ground, shadows, extra figures

Use case: stylized-concept

Style/medium: crisp pixel art in the style of Image 2 (style only, do not copy its characters): clean chunky pixels, one-art-pixel dark plum outline, 3-tone cel shading per material, cozy pastel palette, no dithering, no gradients, no blur; chibi proportions exactly as the mannequins
Lighting: soft light from DIRECTLY ABOVE; the two visible side faces share the SAME mid tone. No cast shadows.
Background: fully transparent background (alpha). If transparency is impossible, use a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 background.
Avoid: bodies, necks, props, text, numbers, frame borders, ground, shadows, extra figures

assets.subject: BASE BODY for a paper-doll system, the SAME plain mannequin-like person in all 10 frames: light peach skin; a completely BALD smooth round head with NO hair and NO face features (a separate head sprite will cover it); a plain tight light-grey long-sleeve base shirt; plain tight mid-grey leggings to the ankles; simple dark-brown shoes. Nothing else. every figure faces the LOWER-LEFT (front three-quarter view). Frames left to right, top row then bottom row: 1-2 standing idle, 3-6 walking (both legs attached at the hips, swinging from the hip joint), 7-8 seated idle in the air at chair height with hands on the thighs, 9-10 seated typing with forearms forward.

BASE BODY for a paper-doll system, the SAME plain mannequin-like person in all 10 frames: light peach skin; a completely BALD smooth round head with NO hair and NO face features (a separate head sprite will cover it); a plain tight light-grey long-sleeve base shirt; plain tight mid-grey leggings to the ankles; simple dark-brown shoes. Nothing else. every figure faces away toward the UPPER-RIGHT (back three-quarter view). Frames left to right, top row then bottom row: 1-2 standing idle, 3-6 walking (both legs attached at the hips, swinging from the hip joint), 7-8 seated idle in the air at chair height with hands on the thighs, 9-10 seated typing with forearms forward.

assets.roles: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: 8 grey head spheres in a 4x2 grid on a transparent background (a tiny box marks where the face points; do not draw it). Edit Image 1: paint a chibi head (face and hair) over each sphere at EXACTLY the same size and position; hair may extend at most 10% beyond the sphere outline; no neck, no body, no shoulders. Image 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY (match its skin tone, outline and face style).
assets.subject: 4 hairstyles, each painted twice side by side: odd columns = front three-quarter view facing the LOWER-LEFT with the face visible (simple dark eyes, tiny mouth, light peach skin); even columns = back three-quarter view facing away to the UPPER-RIGHT (back of the head, no face). Row 1, columns 1-2: short tousled brown hair. Row 1, columns 3-4: long brown hair in a low ponytail with side-swept bangs. Row 2, columns 1-2: black bowl-cut hair with thin round glasses (glasses only on the front view). Row 2, columns 3-4: wavy shoulder-length orange-brown bob.
